text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research article that explicitly develops and implements spatially explicit land-use change scenarios for the entire nation of Brazil (national-scale). The primary research focus is on LULC prediction/simulation, refining global SSPs with a regional model. The study implements three distinct future scenarios (SSP1/RCP1.9, SSP2/RCP4.5, SSP3/RCP7.0) with quantitative comparisons of projected land class areas. It employs the LuccME spatial allocation model, reports quantitative validation metrics (e.g., 84.44% spatial fit, omission/commission errors), and produces mapped LULC projections for 2000-2050.)
